comment: Standard OBD-II PIDs verified on a 2019 Tacoma (2GR-FKS 3.5L V6), including the odometer via standard PID A6. On this truck the engine/transmission ECUs answer ONLY functional OBD on 7DF->7E8; physical 7E0 does not respond, so these rows use the functional header (ATSH7DF) and must not use ATSH7E0;ATCRA7E8; as the Corolla/Sienna profiles do. Fuel level is not included yet, see the PR description for a candidate PID that still needs on-vehicle verification.
